# ESTAMPIE

> A mediæval groovebox: custom firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 synthesiser. GPL-3.0-only; not affiliated with M-VAVE.

Part of Drew Robinson's FM-1 projects: https://fm-1.drewr.dev/ . Source: https://github.com/ocean/estampie

This is a placeholder until ESTAMPIE's first release publishes its site here, with this file listing its pages.
